name: sentinal-mt5
description: Sentinal MT5 - XAUUSD algorithmic trading platform with multi-position execution

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace engine && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.publish:local: npm run build:standalone --workspace web && cp web/dist-standalone/index.html index.html && cp web/dist-standalone/404.html 404.html && cp web/dist-standalone/manifest.webmanifest manifest.webmanifest && cp web/dist-standalone/sw.js sw.js && mkdir -p icons && cp web/dist-standalone/icons/*.png icons/
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace engine && npm run test --workspace web
